body: Unlearning a fact in one language does not guarantee its removal in others as changing the query or even the requested answer language can reopen seemingly forgotten knowledge -- a cross-lingual loophole. The most straightforward solution to this challenge -- unlearning in all languages -- is neither scalable nor desirable as it amplifies damage to unrelated model capabilities. We introduce the task of language budgeted multilingual unlearning where the goal is to select a subset of languages that maximizes cross-lingual erasure. To study this task we introduce the Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor, an unlearning benchmark that spans 174 language--script pairs and 25 atomic paraphrase types to examine when forgetting generalizes across linguistic expressions of the same knowledge. We further propose COVER, which selects source languages to maximize predicted COVERage of languages receiving no forget supervision, enabling unlearning on a language budget. Surprisingly, we find naively selecting strong individual sources does not reliably compose into strong source sets motivating our development of COVER. At deployment COVER only requires benign calibration data and access to the frozen model. Across three model families and two disjoint forget sets, COVER reduces mean held-out residual access by 7.8--27.3% relative to uniform source selection. We find these gains extend beyond synthetic benchmarks to real news documents in low-resource language settings using human translated data from the Low Resource Languages for Emergent Incidents (LORELEI) corpus.

summaryZh: 本文深入探讨了大模型遗忘任务中的跨语言漏洞，即在一种语言中遗忘的事实可能在其他语言中被重新激活。研究团队构建了包含 174 种语言的跨语言遗忘基准测试（Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor），并提出了 COVER 方法，通过选择性遗忘策略在有限的语言预算下最大化遗忘效果。该研究不仅揭示了当前遗忘技术的局限性，还为多语言环境下的模型安全提供了可行的优化路径，在低资源语言场景中也表现出显著的有效性。

glossary.explanationZh: 指在一种语言中删除的信息可以通过其他语言的查询被重新提取的现象。
在有限的计算资源或语言覆盖范围内，通过选择性遗忘实现跨语言知识擦除的任务。
一种通过选择源语言来最大化未受监督语言遗忘覆盖率的算法。
模型在执行遗忘操作后，仍能通过特定查询检索到已删除知识的程度。
用于在遗忘过程中校准模型行为，防止性能过度退化的辅助数据。
